storyCards.headline: So Much In Love: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
All-4-one's "So Much In Love" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

So Much In Love was released in 1994.
